editor.pickTitle: Select a lesson, test or assignment on the left
editor.pickHint: The editor will appear here: lesson text and video or test questions.
editor.sectionHint: A section groups lessons: it currently has {count, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}}. Double-click the title to rename it.

page.forbidden: Only the course teacher can edit it.
page.publishBlocked: The course can’t be published: {count, plural, one {# question is incomplete} other {# questions are incomplete}}
page.publishEmpty: The course can’t be published yet: add at least one lesson.

structure.deleteCourseText: The course “{title}” will be deleted together with all sections, lessons, tests and student enrollments. This cannot be undone.
structure.deleteSectionText: The section “{title}” and its {count, plural, one {# lesson} other {# lessons}} will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
structure.deleteLessonText: The lesson “{title}” will be deleted together with its test. This cannot be undone.
structure.empty: The course is empty so far. Add the first section, then lessons and tests inside it.

lesson.title: Lesson title
lesson.uploadedVideoHint: This lesson has an uploaded video. To replace it with a link, first delete it on the “Own file” tab.
lesson.videoUrlInvalid: The link was not recognised. Paste a YouTube or Vimeo video address.
lesson.contentHint: HTML is supported: headings, lists, links, code

files.title: Lesson files
files.hint: PDF, slides, documents, archives, images · up to {mb} MB
files.confirmText: “{name}” will disappear from the lesson for all students.

test.title: Test title
test.noQuestions: The test has no questions yet. Students cannot take it until you add at least one.
test.confirmText: The test “{title}”, its questions and student results will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
test.answersLegend: Answer options for question {index}. Mark the correct ones.
test.partialOrdering: Partial credit for each correct position
test.acceptedEmpty: Add at least one accepted answer.
test.pairsLegend: Pairs “left → right”. Students see the right column shuffled.
test.pairsMin: At least 2 complete pairs are needed.
test.itemsLegend: Items in the correct order. Students see them shuffled.
test.essayHint: The teacher grades the answer in Manage → Tests. Until then the result is “Under review”.
test.questionCount: Each attempt: {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}
test.bankEmpty: This course has no question bank yet. Create categories on the “Question bank” tab.
test.randomHint: Each attempt gets the given number of random questions from the category.
test.randomTooMany: The category has fewer questions — all will be used.
test.copySelected: Add {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}
test.copied: Added {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}}

problems.fewOptions: Add at least two answer options.
problems.noAccepted: Add at least one accepted answer.
problems.fewPairs: Fill in at least two pairs.

test.problemHidden: Students won’t get this question and the course can’t be published until it’s complete.
test.incompleteBadge: {count, plural, one {# incomplete question} other {# incomplete questions}}

assignment.title: Assignment title
assignment.descriptionHint: HTML is supported: paragraphs, lists, links, code
assignment.confirmText: “{title}” and all work handed in by students will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

bank.intro: Bank questions can be copied into tests or drawn at random: “N questions from a category” in the test settings.
bank.emptyHint: Create a category or import questions in GIFT (Moodle) format.
bank.deleteText: Category “{name}” and its {count, plural, one {# question} other {# questions}} will be deleted. Copies in tests stay.
bank.tooLarge: The file is too large (max 500 KB).
bank.importHint: Supported: choice, multiple answers, true/false, short answer, numeric, matching, essay. $CATEGORY creates categories.
